metadata.short_desc: An all-in-one anime companion: 41 chat commands plus a dashboard page for search, watchlists, feeds, broadcasts and gacha.
metadata.desc: Bangumi Nexus merges Bangumi, bangumi-data, anime1.me, Nagato Bandou, AGE, Moegirlpedia, Mikan and RSSHub into one cross-source anime index: subject search and the daily calendar, season tables, watchlists with progress tracking, RSS and Mikan subscriptions, a scheduled new-episode broadcast that the AstrBot persona can narrate, random gacha picks and AutoBangumi webhook intake - all rendered with six polished card themes and managed from a dashboard page.

card_theme.hint: Every card (calendar / subject / watchlist / update / gacha / help) shares this palette. You can also switch it per chat with the theme argument of the help command.

card_renderer.hint: auto = headless browser -> Pillow -> AstrBot text-to-image -> plain text, falling back step by step. Pick text to always reply with plain text.
labels: auto - fall back step by step (recommended)

card_width.hint: 760-1200. Too narrow feels cramped, too wide needs zooming on phones.

bangumi_access_token.hint: Optional: read-only endpoints work without it. Generating one at https://next.bgm.tv/demo/access-token raises your quota and reduces 429 errors.

user_agent.hint: Leave empty to use the built-in UA. Bangumi asks every client to identify itself in the UA.

proxy.hint: Such as http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://127.0.0.1:1080. Empty means direct connection.

http_max_retries.hint: Exponential backoff, applied only to timeouts, 5xx and 429.

cache_ttl_minutes.hint: In-memory cache for slow-changing data such as the calendar, season tables and anime lists. 0 disables caching.

max_concurrency.hint: How many requests may run at once while fetching covers or batching subject lookups. Too high invites rate limiting.

enable_cross_match.hint: When on, one card shows the Bangumi score, air time, anime1 watch link, staff and cast from Nagato Bandou, plus the Mikan RSS URL. Turn it off to query Bangumi only, which is faster.

translate_summary.hint: Uses the LLM provider already configured in AstrBot, so it consumes tokens.

translate_provider_id.hint: Leave empty to use whatever provider the current session is on.

long_reply_as_card.hint: Replies longer than 200 characters or containing several lines are sent as an image instead, to avoid flooding the chat.

push_enabled.hint: Pushes the today-on-air card to the target sessions below on a schedule.

push_time.hint: 24-hour HH:MM. Use commas for several slots, for example 08:30,20:00. Interpreted in the bot host's local timezone.

push_targets.hint: Full unified message origins, such as aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456. A group can also subscribe itself by sending the calendar-subscribe command.

push_min_score.hint: Shows rated below this are skipped; 0 disables the filter. Brand-new shows often have no rating yet, so a high value hides them.

persona_reply_enabled.description: Let the AstrBot persona narrate notifications
persona_reply_enabled.hint: When on, daily broadcasts, RSS updates and Webhook notifications first get one line in the voice of the active persona, sent together with the card. The plugin only supplies the task instruction; the persona itself comes from AstrBot.

persona_id.hint: Which persona should narrate the notifications. Leave empty to follow the target session's default persona; when neither resolves, only the card is sent.

persona_provider_id.hint: Leave empty to use the provider the target session is currently on. If none resolves, narration is skipped and only the card is sent.

persona_instruction.hint: Describe only what to do. Do not define a character here - tone and personality come from the AstrBot persona settings.

persona_max_chars.hint: Longer output is truncated so the persona cannot push the card out of view.

rss_interval_minutes.hint: Minimum 5. Neither Mikan nor RSSHub enjoys being hammered; 15-30 minutes is plenty.

rss_max_items_per_poll.description: Maximum items pushed per feed per poll
rss_max_items_per_poll.hint: Keeps a feed that suddenly returns dozens of items from flooding the chat; the rest is recorded but not pushed.

rss_first_poll_silent.description: Skip history on a feed's first poll
rss_first_poll_silent.hint: Strongly recommended: otherwise a fresh subscription replays its whole backlog immediately.

rsshub_base.hint: Used to expand /rsshub routes into full URLs. A self-hosted instance is more reliable.

mikan_base.hint: Used to build per-show RSS feeds. Switch to a mirror domain if the main site is slow for you.

webhook_enabled.hint: Exposes an HTTP endpoint so downloaders such as AutoBangumi can push events like episode-downloaded.

webhook_path.hint: The full URL becomes http(s)://<your-astrbot>/api/<this path>.

webhook_token.hint: Empty means no verification, which is not recommended. Once set, requests must carry a matching X-Webhook-Token header.

webhook_notify_watchers.description: Notify only sessions tracking the show
webhook_notify_watchers.hint: Besides the fixed targets, sessions whose watchlist contains the show also get notified. Handy when one downloader serves several groups without cross-flooding them.

webhook_auto_progress.description: Advance watch progress on new episodes
webhook_auto_progress.hint: When a download-complete or import event arrives, move the matching watchlist entry to that episode. It only moves forward, never back.

webhook_port.hint: 0 keeps it off, meaning only the AstrBot dashboard route /api/plug/ is used and a logged-in dashboard session is required. Setting 1-65535 starts a tiny extra HTTP server dedicated to webhooks so AutoBangumi can reach it directly; a webhook token is mandatory in that case, otherwise the listener refuses to start.

webhook_bind.hint: The interface the standalone listener binds to. Use 127.0.0.1 when the downloader runs on the same machine so nothing else can reach it.

dedup_window_seconds.hint: The same notification arriving twice inside the window is sent only once.

anime1_enabled.hint: Provides watch links and the anime list. That site is a third-party aggregator; links are indexed only.

anime1_refresh_hours.hint: Whole hours separated by commas, for example 1,13,22. Empty disables automatic refresh.

default_platform_id.hint: Used to build a full unified message origin when a webhook target only carries a user or group ID.

send_retry_delay_seconds.hint: Exponential backoff: attempt N waits delay x 2^(N-1).

send_concurrency.hint: How many sessions receive a message at the same time. Too high can trip platform rate limits.

gacha_source.hint: yuc = Nagato Bandou season table with staff, cast and genres; bangumi = the Bangumi daily calendar; auto = try yuc first and fall back to Bangumi.
labels: auto - yuc first, Bangumi as fallback

webui_enabled.hint: When off no web route is registered at all; chat commands keep working.

webui_theme.hint: Used the first time the page opens; after that the theme picked in the page wins.

nexus.title: Bangumi Nexus
nexus.desc: Search, watchlists, RSS feeds, daily broadcasts and card previews in one panel.
